summary: r3 fixes the single r2 pessimistic critical: the r2 CLAUDE.md `lvp_icd.x86_64.json -> lvp_icd.json` swap + the AT-2840 'contains NO .x86_64' clause were a doc/CI regression. `.x86_64.json` is the CI-canonical Ubuntu path, verified hard-wired in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (6 places: lines 17,18,35,53,54), `BENCHMARKS.md:230`, `crates/axc-runtime/src/lib.rs:45`, `crates/axc-runtime/src/icd.rs:72`. CLAUDE.md's GPU-execution section explicitly documents CI, so the swap desynced it from ci.yml and AT-2840 would have forbidden the exact string CI depends on. Chose option (B): keep CLAUDE.md line 171 on the CI-canonical name and ADD one env-dependent note line; re-word AT-2840 to assert the PRESENCE of the both-names note. Confined to CLAUDE.md's env-var section (one line kept + one line added). Nothing else moved.
chosen_option: B — document BOTH names as environment-dependent in CLAUDE.md's env-var section (CI Ubuntu = lvp_icd.x86_64.json, local Mesa may be lvp_icd.json), and make AT-2840 assert the note's presence. Rationale: (B) is the truthful fix — it keeps CLAUDE.md consistent with ci.yml's 6 refs AND stops the next engineer tripping on the exact ICD-name ambiguity that tripped this pipeline twice (r1 over-generalized the box-local path; r2 faithfully but wrongly applied it). Option (A) (drop the swap + clause entirely) would have been correct-but-silent; (B) additionally records the environment-dependence so the failure mode cannot recur.

changes_this_pass.change: REVERSED the r2 swap. CLAUDE.md line 171 stays exactly as-is on the CI-canonical `VK_DRIVER_FILES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json`. ADD one note line directly beneath it: '_ICD filename is environment-dependent: Ubuntu/CI (`mesa-vulkan-drivers`) installs the arch-suffixed `lvp_icd.x86_64.json` (used above and throughout `ci.yml`); some local Mesa builds name it `lvp_icd.json` (no suffix). Run `ls /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/` to confirm which is present._'. Confined to CLAUDE.md's env-var section: one existing line kept + one line added. BENCHMARKS.md:230, the two axc-runtime doc-comments, and ci.yml are NOT touched (all correctly CI-canonical).

DELETED the r2 'assert CLAUDE.md contains NO lvp_icd.x86_64.json' clause (it forbade the CI-canonical string and would have gone red the moment anyone re-aligned CLAUDE.md with ci.yml). REPLACED with: assert CLAUDE.md contains BOTH `lvp_icd.x86_64.json` (CI-canonical, must not be removed) AND `lvp_icd.json` (box-local alternate in the env-note). `lvp_icd.json` is not a substring of `lvp_icd.x86_64.json`, so the plain contains-check passes only when the env-note is genuinely present — asserts the PRESENCE of the both-names note instead of forbidding `.x86_64`. body.rs `cap = 6` grep-negative and BENCHMARKS.md `Last updated: M3.15` assertions unchanged.
